q: Our sub-meters add up to less than the main electricity meter. Which do we report?
title: Sub-meters below the main meter
short: Report the main meter, the discom bill. The gap is normal: cable and transformer losses, unmetered loads such as lighting, and meter error. For allocating emissions to lines or tenants, share the gap in proportion to sub-meter readings and say so. A gap that keeps growing is worth investigating.

ul: Losses in internal cables and transformers.
Sub-meters not calibrated or read on different days.

p: Monthly main meter total, sum of sub-meters and the difference in percent. A verifier will ask why it moved.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site, and labels estimates as estimates.
